summary: ~32% of corpus chunks (994/3089, v27) are retrievable but are apparatus/boilerplate, not content: site nav ('Sacred Texts... Previous Next'), tables of contents ('Next: Chapter IV', 'Next: Book XI'), and editorial/manuscript footnotes ('the word aidum stood... in his MS'). Found via the tuning experiment (59060e24): LLM-judged precision@10 is ~0.2 corpus-wide and ~0.00 for distinctive small-tradition queries because the surfaced chunks are this junk (Zoroastrian Gathas results are philological footnotes, not doctrine). This — not ranking weights (which moved precision <0.06) — is the dominant retrieval-precision lever. FIX IS UPSTREAM in the guru pipeline chunker: filter/strip apparatus at ingestion + re-export. Cross-repo. Evidence: docs/concept-hierarchy/tuning-experiment.md Round 2.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Round-2b (query-time quality filter) proves the upstream fix must RE-EMBED on cleaned text, not just strip strings: stripping boilerplate from chunk bodies at query time barely moved precision (0.20->0.24) because the vectors still carry the boilerplate, so the same chunks are retrieved. Cleaning + re-export without re-embedding will NOT fix retrieval relevance.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Substantially resolved at the SOURCE by guru repo todo:fccaf47d (2026-07-04): corpus-wide V8 audit found pollution had already dropped from the v27-era 32% to ~7% residual; clean_bodies.py stripped ~1,050 chunks in place (nav, credits, page markers, orphan titles), full re-embed over clean bodies (4,176 x 768d), and retriever.ts patterns hardened as defense-in-depth (guru-web branch chore/v8-apparatus-sync). Remaining runtime exposure is only the currently-deployed v3 corpus; closure rides the v4 deploy (docs/summary-phase-w.md W6). Whole-chunk apparatus remnants tracked in guru todo:50438e23.

resolution.note: Resolved at source by the guru V8 chunk-level clean (P1-P6) + full re-embed, shipped in the v4 corpus deployed 2026-07-09. Runtime quality filter retained as defense-in-depth (its tests are the regression net). Prod verified.
